title: Austin Budget Forecast Discussed
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to discuss the foundational assumptions for the upcoming 1989-1990 city budget forecast.
*   Financial Services Department staff presented initial projections and answered questions from attendees.
*   This gathering served as an informational session for preliminary budget planning, with no final policy decisions made.
